propositions: Read-only derivations over gate sidecars compute LLM cost proxy, latency, cost-per-accepted-change, first-pass verification, and env-diagnosis intervals without writing any state.
LLM cost metrics (llm_calls, latency) are sourced exclusively from REVIEW_RESULT.metrics; COMPLETION_VERDICT carries no metrics block and is used only for pass/fail outcomes.
Accepted change is defined as a completion_verifier_pass_v1 record (ticket closed successfully), distinct from plan_review PASS which only clears the claim gate.
cost_per_accepted_change sums REVIEW_RESULT.metrics.llm_calls divided by count of completion_verifier_pass_v1 records, returning None when zero accepted closes to avoid division by zero.

env_diagnosis_interval pairs each gate_error_v1 ERROR record with the next PASS record for the same gate (matching on ERROR.gate field), computing interval as PASS.timestamp − ERROR.timestamp; an ERROR with no following same-gate PASS represents an open unclosed diagnosis interval.

first_pass_verification computes the fraction of tickets whose earliest COMPLETION_VERDICT record (oldest-first chronological order) is a completion_verifier_pass_v1 record, indicating first-attempt pass on close verification.
